This is a wooden cabinet for storing objects, likely classified in heading 9403 as other wooden furniture. The question is which subheading applies.

9403.60.80 covers other wooden furniture, and its statistical suffix is 9403.60.8081 (other). Bedroom furniture (9403.50) and kitchen furniture (9403.40) do not fit. A record player stand is used in a living room, so it falls under 9403.60.80.

The unassembled state does not change this under GRI 2(a), because the product is presented as unassembled furniture. The country of origin question (USMCA or Chapter 98 treatment) does not affect the classification itself.

Rulings of this type typically give 9403.60.8081, so I am using that code.

{"hts_code": "9403.60.8081", "reason": "An unassembled wooden storage cabinet (record player stand) is classified as other wooden furniture under heading 9403, subheading 9403.60.80, by GRI 1 and 2(a)."}
